WSIS IMPLEMENTATION BY
ACTION LINE
The
Tunis Agenda for the Information Society
states that the
WSIS
implementation mechanism at the international level
should
be organised taking into account the themes and action lines in
the Geneva Plan of Action, and moderated or facilitated by UN
agencies when appropriate. It also states that
ITU, UNESCO and UNDP
should play a leading facilitating role in the implementation of
the Geneva Plan of Action.
